```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# Run times
# The full run (50 baseline replications, 12 sensitivity scenarios x 8
# replications, 10 stress replications) takes hours. Results are cached in
# saved/ and read back on later knits.
#   DES_QUICK=1  runs 3 / 2 / 2 replications into saved_quick/ for a check
#   DES_RERUN=1  ignores the cache and runs the simulations again
quick <- nzchar(Sys.getenv("DES_QUICK"))
rerun <- nzchar(Sys.getenv("DES_RERUN"))
n_rep_base   <- if (quick) 3 else 50
n_rep_stress <- if (quick) 2 else 10
n_rep_sens   <- if (quick) 2 else 8

cache_dir <- if (quick) "saved_quick" else "saved"
dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Run expr and save the result, or read it back if it is already saved
cached <- function(file, expr) {
  path <- file.path(cache_dir, file)
  if (file.exists(path) && !rerun) return(readRDS(path))
  x <- expr
  saveRDS(x, path)
  x
}
```

# 2. Global simulation settings

```{r sim-settings}
sim_days     <- 60                
sim_horizon  <- sim_days * 24 * 60       
warm_up      <- 14 * 24 * 60             
```

# 3. Service-time distributions (simplified: mean + CV)

I reparameterise all job-cycle distributions using mean and coefficient
of variation (CV). For a Gamma(shape = k, scale = theta):
  mean = k * theta and SD = theta * sqrt(k), so CV = 1/sqrt(k).
Hence shape = 1 / CV^2 and scale = mean * CV^2.

This lets me specify each component by its clinical mean (minutes) and
a single spread parameter (CV), which is both easier to defend and
easier to tune. Means are centred on Northern Ireland / UK ambulance
benchmarks; scene times now decrease monotonically from C1 to C4 to
reflect that higher-acuity cases require longer on-scene interventions
(CPR, ALS, stabilisation).

```{r service-times}
# Helper: sample once from a Gamma with chosen shape k and target mean mu.
# Under Gamma(shape = k, scale = theta):
#   mean     = k * theta
#   variance = k * theta^2
# So setting theta = mu / k gives a Gamma with the target mean while
# letting shape k control how concentrated the distribution is (larger
# k => tighter around the mean; k = 1 is exponential).
rgamma_mean <- function(mean, shape) {
  scale <- mean / shape
  rgamma(1, shape = shape, scale = scale)
}

# Job-cycle means (minutes) and gamma shape parameters, by category.
# Shape values reflect empirical spread for each activity:
#   shape = 4  --> high variability (travel, transport: geography-driven)
#   shape = 6  --> moderate (scene time, clinical handover)
#   shape = 10 --> low variability (mobilisation, clearance)
# Smaller shape = wider spread; larger shape = tighter around the mean.

job_params <- tibble::tribble(
  ~component,    ~C1,  ~C2,  ~C3,  ~C4,  ~shape,
  "mobilise",     1.5,  1.5,  1.5,  1.5, 10,
  "travel",       7.0, 16.0, 20.0, 22.0,  4,
  "scene",       35.0, 28.0, 22.0, 18.0,  6,
  "transport",    7.0, 16.0, 20.0, 22.0,  4,
  "handover",    17.0, 15.0, 13.0, 12.0,  6,
  "clear",        6.0,  6.0,  6.0,  6.0, 10
)

# Uniform samplers (mobilise, clear) 
make_uniform_sampler <- function(component) {
  row <- job_params[job_params$component == component, ]
  mean_val <- row$C1
  shape    <- row$shape
  function() rgamma_mean(mean_val, shape)
}

# Category samplers 
make_cat_sampler <- function(component) {
  row <- job_params[job_params$component == component, ]
  shape <- row$shape
  function(cat) {
    mean_val <- row[[cat]]
    rgamma_mean(mean_val, shape)
  }
}

mobilise_time   <- make_uniform_sampler("mobilise")
clear_time      <- make_uniform_sampler("clear")
travel_to_scene <- make_cat_sampler("travel")
scene_time      <- make_cat_sampler("scene")
transport_time  <- make_cat_sampler("transport")
clinical_handover_time <- make_cat_sampler("handover")
```

# 4. Handover

```{r handover-params}
use_handover_queue <- TRUE
handover_capacity  <- 5

# Conveyance probabilities (Papakonstantinou 2024)
convey_prob <- c(
  C1 = 0.741,
  C2 = 0.727,
  C3 = 0.059,
  C4 = 0.012  
)
```

# 5. Demand inputs

```{r demand-inputs}
# Annual incident volume calibrated to NIAS 2024/25 attended incidents
annual_incidents <- 173695

# Category mix from NIAS 2022/23 published figures.
# C1 includes Cat1 + Cat1T merged into one high-urgency group.
cat_share <- c(
  C1 = (12793 + 9088) / 148545,
  C2 =  93383         / 148545,
  C3 =  32280         / 148545,
  C4 =   1001         / 148545
)

annual_by_cat <- annual_incidents * cat_share
weekly_by_cat <- annual_by_cat / 52.1429  # avg weeks per year
daily_by_cat  <- annual_by_cat / 365

weekly_by_cat

#Weekly demand profile

demand_mode <- "data"

weekly_counts_mat <- as.matrix(ambulance_rows[, hour_names])

if (demand_mode == "data") {
  weekly_profile <- weekly_counts_mat / base::sum(weekly_counts_mat)
} else {
  hour_profile <- colSums(weekly_counts_mat)
  hour_profile <- hour_profile / sum(hour_profile)
  # replicate the 24-hour profile to every day, normalise to 168 cells
  weekly_profile <- matrix(rep(hour_profile, each = 7), nrow = 7) / 7
  dimnames(weekly_profile) <- list(day_order, hour_names)
}

stopifnot(abs(sum(weekly_profile) - 1) < 1e-10)

# Category-specific weekly demand rates (expected counts per hour block)
c1_weekly <- weekly_by_cat["C1"] * weekly_profile
c2_weekly <- weekly_by_cat["C2"] * weekly_profile
c3_weekly <- weekly_by_cat["C3"] * weekly_profile
c4_weekly <- weekly_by_cat["C4"] * weekly_profile
```


# 6. Ambulance staffing schedule

```{r staffing}
# NIAS DCA availability by day of week (NI Assembly answer 2025)
# Flat staffing: average across weekdays, applied every day
day_dca_raw   <- rep(round(mean(c(65,64,64,64,62,60,60))), 7)
night_dca_raw <- rep(round(mean(c(47,47,47,47,52,52,51))), 7)

# Share effectively dispatchable (as opposed to on-break, off-road, etc.)
dispatchable_fraction <- 0.80
day_dca   <- round(day_dca_raw   * dispatchable_fraction)
night_dca <- round(night_dca_raw * dispatchable_fraction)

# 24-hour profile for a given day:
#   00-05  night core        (6 hours)
#   06-07  ramp up            (2 hours)
#   08-17  day core          (10 hours)
#   18-19  ramp down          (2 hours)
#   20-23  night core         (4 hours)
make_daily_staff_profile <- function(day_val, night_val) {
  c(rep(night_val, 6),
    rep(round((night_val + day_val) / 2), 2),
    rep(day_val, 10),
    rep(round((night_val + day_val) / 2), 2),
    rep(night_val, 4))
}

weekly_staff_by_hour <- unlist(
  lapply(seq_len(7), function(i) make_daily_staff_profile(day_dca[i], night_dca[i]))
)
stopifnot(length(weekly_staff_by_hour) == 168)

amb_schedule <- schedule(
  timetable = seq(0, by = 60, length.out = 168),
  values    = weekly_staff_by_hour,
  period    = 7 * 24 * 60
)

# Maximum queue wait before renege. C1/C2 never renege; C3/C4 do.
max_wait_by_cat <- c(C1 = Inf, C2 = Inf, C3 = 720, C4 = 360)
```

# 8. Trajectory builder

```{r trajectory}
make_call_trajectory <- function(env, cat, convey_prob_local,
                                 max_wait = Inf,
                                 use_handover_queue = TRUE,
                                 clinical_handover_fn = clinical_handover_time) {

  # no-convey branch
  no_convey_traj <- trajectory(paste0("no_convey_", cat)) %>%
    set_attribute("conveyed", 0) %>%
    timeout(clear_time)

  # convey branch: with or without a handover queue 
  if (use_handover_queue) {
    convey_traj <- trajectory(paste0("convey_", cat)) %>%
      set_attribute("conveyed", 1) %>%
      timeout(function() transport_time(cat)) %>%
      set_attribute("handover_arrive", function() now(env)) %>%
      seize("handover", 1) %>%
      set_attribute("handover_queue_wait",
                    function() now(env) - get_attribute(env, "handover_arrive")) %>%
      timeout(function() clinical_handover_fn(cat)) %>%
      set_attribute("handover_duration",
                    function() now(env) - get_attribute(env, "handover_arrive")) %>%
      release("handover", 1) %>%
      timeout(clear_time)
  } else {
    convey_traj <- trajectory(paste0("convey_", cat)) %>%
      set_attribute("conveyed", 1) %>%
      timeout(function() transport_time(cat)) %>%
      set_attribute("handover_arrive", function() now(env)) %>%
      timeout(function() clinical_handover_fn(cat)) %>%
      set_attribute("handover_duration",
                    function() now(env) - get_attribute(env, "handover_arrive")) %>%
      timeout(clear_time)
  }

  # main: queue for ambulance, respond
  main <- trajectory(paste("traj", cat)) %>%
    set_attribute("arrival_time", function() now(env)) %>%
    set_attribute("expired", 0)

  if (is.finite(max_wait)) {
    expire_traj <- trajectory(paste0(cat, "_expired")) %>%
      set_attribute("expired", 1)
    main <- main %>% renege_in(max_wait, out = expire_traj)
  }

  main <- main %>% seize("ambulances", 1)

  if (is.finite(max_wait)) {
    main <- main %>% renege_abort()
  }

  main <- main %>%
    set_attribute("queue_wait",
                  function() now(env) - get_attribute(env, "arrival_time")) %>%
    timeout(mobilise_time) %>%
    timeout(function() travel_to_scene(cat)) %>%
    set_attribute("response_time",
                  function() now(env) - get_attribute(env, "arrival_time")) %>%
    timeout(function() scene_time(cat)) %>%
    branch(
      function() ifelse(runif(1) < convey_prob_local[[cat]], 2, 1),
      continue = c(TRUE, TRUE),
      no_convey_traj,
      convey_traj
    ) %>%
    release("ambulances", 1)

  main
}
```

# 9. Arrival generator

```{r arrival-gen}
# Non-homogeneous Poisson: piecewise rate over the 7x24 lattice,
# wrapped to a weekly period.
make_interarrival <- function(env, lambda_weekly, start_day = 1) {
  force(env); force(lambda_weekly); force(start_day)
  function() {
    current_time <- now(env)
    sim_day  <- floor(current_time / (24 * 60))
    day_idx  <- ((start_day - 1 + sim_day) %% 7) + 1
    minute_in_day <- current_time %% (24 * 60)
    hour_idx <- floor(minute_in_day / 60) + 1

    rate_per_hour <- lambda_weekly[day_idx, hour_idx]
    rate_per_min  <- rate_per_hour / 60

    if (rate_per_min <= 0) return(60 - (minute_in_day %% 60))
    rexp(1, rate = rate_per_min)
  }
}
```

# 10. Single-replication runner

```{r single-rep}
run_one_rep <- function(
  scenario_name            = "Baseline",
  demand_mult              = 1,
  staff_mult               = 1,
  handover_capacity_delta  = 0,     # additive bays (+1, -1, etc.)
  convey_mult              = 1,
  shape_mult               = 1,     # power transform on demand profile (not used)
  seed                     = NULL
) {

  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)

  # Local demand profile
  prof_local <- weekly_profile ^ shape_mult
  prof_local <- prof_local / sum(prof_local)

  c1_local <- weekly_by_cat["C1"] * prof_local * demand_mult
  c2_local <- weekly_by_cat["C2"] * prof_local * demand_mult
  c3_local <- weekly_by_cat["C3"] * prof_local * demand_mult
  c4_local <- weekly_by_cat["C4"] * prof_local * demand_mult

  # Local staffing
  staff_local <- pmax(1, round(weekly_staff_by_hour * staff_mult))
  amb_sched_local <- schedule(
    timetable = seq(0, by = 60, length.out = 168),
    values    = staff_local,
    period    = 7 * 24 * 60
  )

  # Local conveyance probabilities
  convey_local <- convey_prob
  convey_local["C2"] <- min(0.99, convey_local["C2"] * convey_mult)
  convey_local["C3"] <- min(0.99, convey_local["C3"] * convey_mult)
  convey_local["C4"] <- min(0.99, convey_local["C4"] * convey_mult)

  # Local handover capacity (additive: baseline +/- bays)
  ho_cap_local <- max(1, handover_capacity + handover_capacity_delta)

  # Build environment
  env <- simmer(paste0("scen_", scenario_name))

  c1_traj <- make_call_trajectory(env, "C1", convey_local,
                                  max_wait = max_wait_by_cat["C1"],
                                  use_handover_queue = use_handover_queue)
  c2_traj <- make_call_trajectory(env, "C2", convey_local,
                                  max_wait = max_wait_by_cat["C2"],
                                  use_handover_queue = use_handover_queue)
  c3_traj <- make_call_trajectory(env, "C3", convey_local,
                                  max_wait = max_wait_by_cat["C3"],
                                  use_handover_queue = use_handover_queue)
  c4_traj <- make_call_trajectory(env, "C4", convey_local,
                                  max_wait = max_wait_by_cat["C4"],
                                  use_handover_queue = use_handover_queue)

  env <- env %>%
    add_resource("ambulances", capacity = amb_sched_local,
                 queue_size = Inf, preemptive = FALSE)

  if (use_handover_queue) {
    env <- env %>% add_resource("handover",
                                capacity   = ho_cap_local,
                                queue_size = Inf)
  }

  env <- env %>%
    add_generator("C1_", c1_traj, make_interarrival(env, c1_local),
                  priority = 4, mon = 2) %>%
    add_generator("C2_", c2_traj, make_interarrival(env, c2_local),
                  priority = 3, mon = 2) %>%
    add_generator("C3_", c3_traj, make_interarrival(env, c3_local),
                  priority = 2, mon = 2) %>%
    add_generator("C4_", c4_traj, make_interarrival(env, c4_local),
                  priority = 1, mon = 2)

  run(env, until = sim_horizon)

  # Extract outputs
  arrivals_all <- get_mon_arrivals(env) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      category = dplyr::case_when(
        startsWith(name, "C1_") ~ "C1",
        startsWith(name, "C2_") ~ "C2",
        startsWith(name, "C3_") ~ "C3",
        startsWith(name, "C4_") ~ "C4",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      total_time = end_time - start_time
    )
  arrivals <- arrivals_all %>% dplyr::filter(start_time >= warm_up)

  # Per-call attributes
  attrs <- get_mon_attributes(env) %>%
    dplyr::filter(key %in% c("queue_wait", "response_time", "conveyed",
                             "expired", "handover_duration",
                             "handover_queue_wait")) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(name, key) %>%
    dplyr::slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      category = dplyr::case_when(
        startsWith(name, "C1_") ~ "C1",
        startsWith(name, "C2_") ~ "C2",
        startsWith(name, "C3_") ~ "C3",
        startsWith(name, "C4_") ~ "C4",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(name, category, key, value) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = value, values_fill = 0)

  # Category KPIs (exclude expired calls as they never got an ambulance)
  kpis_by_category <- arrivals %>%
    dplyr::left_join(attrs, by = c("name", "category")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(expired = dplyr::coalesce(expired, 0)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(category) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_calls            = dplyr::n(),
      n_finished         = sum(finished, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_expired          = sum(expired == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_expired        = mean(expired == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_queue_wait    = mean(queue_wait[finished & expired == 0],      na.rm = TRUE),
      p95_queue_wait     = quantile(queue_wait[finished & expired == 0], 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_response_time = mean(response_time[finished & expired == 0],   na.rm = TRUE),
      p95_response_time  = quantile(response_time[finished & expired == 0], 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Resource summary
  resource_summary <- get_mon_resources(env) %>%
    dplyr::filter(time >= warm_up) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(resource, time) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(resource) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      next_time = dplyr::lead(time, default = sim_horizon),
      dt = next_time - time
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      avg_busy     = weighted.mean(server, dt, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_queue    = weighted.mean(queue,  dt, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_capacity = weighted.mean(capacity, dt, na.rm = TRUE),
      utilisation  = avg_busy / avg_capacity,
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Handover summary
  handover_monitor <- attrs %>%
    dplyr::filter(handover_duration > 0) %>%
    dplyr::select(name, category, handover_duration, handover_queue_wait)

  handover_summary <- handover_monitor %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_handover     = dplyr::n(),
      mean_handover  = mean(handover_duration,     na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_ho_queue  = mean(handover_queue_wait,   na.rm = TRUE),
      p95_handover   = quantile(handover_duration, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_over_60    = mean(handover_duration > 60,  na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_over_180   = mean(handover_duration > 180, na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  # Resource time series (for queue-length plots)
  resource_ts <- get_mon_resources(env) %>%
    dplyr::filter(time >= warm_up)

  list(
    scenario         = scenario_name,
    arrivals         = arrivals,
    attrs            = attrs,
    kpis_by_category = kpis_by_category,
    resource_summary = resource_summary,
    handover_monitor = handover_monitor,
    handover_summary = handover_summary,
    resource_ts      = resource_ts
  )
}
```

# 11. Multi-replication runner

```{r multi-rep}
run_one_scenario <- function(
  scenario_name = "Baseline",
  demand_mult              = 1,
  staff_mult               = 1,
  handover_capacity_delta  = 0,
  convey_mult              = 1,
  shape_mult               = 1,
  n_rep                    = 50,     
  seed_start               = 4001
) {
  rep_runs <- purrr::map(
    seq_len(n_rep),
    function(i) run_one_rep(
      scenario_name           = paste0(scenario_name, "_rep", i),
      demand_mult             = demand_mult,
      staff_mult              = staff_mult,
      handover_capacity_delta = handover_capacity_delta,
      convey_mult             = convey_mult,
      shape_mult              = shape_mult,
      seed                    = seed_start + i - 1
    )
  )

  bind_tag <- function(extract) {
    purrr::map2_dfr(rep_runs, seq_len(n_rep),
                    function(r, i) extract(r) %>% dplyr::mutate(rep = i))
  }

  kpis_all    <- bind_tag(function(r) r$kpis_by_category)
  res_all     <- bind_tag(function(r) r$resource_summary)
  ho_all      <- bind_tag(function(r) r$handover_summary)
  arrivals_all<- bind_tag(function(r) r$arrivals)
  attrs_all   <- bind_tag(function(r) r$attrs)
  ho_mon_all  <- bind_tag(function(r) r$handover_monitor)
  res_ts_all  <- bind_tag(function(r) r$resource_ts)

  kpis_mean <- kpis_all %>%
    dplyr::group_by(category) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_calls            = mean(n_calls,            na.rm = TRUE),
      n_finished         = mean(n_finished,         na.rm = TRUE),
      n_expired          = mean(n_expired,          na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_expired        = mean(pct_expired,        na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_queue_wait    = mean(mean_queue_wait,    na.rm = TRUE),
      p95_queue_wait     = mean(p95_queue_wait,     na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_response_time = mean(mean_response_time, na.rm = TRUE),
      p95_response_time  = mean(p95_response_time,  na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  list(
    scenario             = scenario_name,
    rep_runs             = rep_runs,
    kpis_by_category     = kpis_mean,
    kpis_by_category_all = kpis_all,
    resource_summary_all = res_all,
    handover_summary_all = ho_all,
    handover_monitor_all = ho_mon_all,
    arrivals             = arrivals_all,
    attrs                = attrs_all,
    resource_ts_all      = res_ts_all
  )
}
```

# 12. Run the baseline

```{r run-baseline}
# 60 simulated days per replication, the first 14 days discarded as warm-up
baseline_run <- cached(
  "des_baseline_run.rds",
  run_one_scenario(scenario_name = "Baseline",
                   n_rep         = n_rep_base,
                   seed_start    = 4001)
)

baseline_run$kpis_by_category
```

# 14. Figure B: response-time decomposition (NEW)

Breaks mean response time into the travel/mobilisation component and the
queue-wait component, showing which is the dominant driver of delay for
each category.

```{r fig-decomposition, fig.height=4, fig.width=7}
decomp <- baseline_run$kpis_by_category_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(category) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_resp    = mean(mean_response_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_queue   = mean(mean_queue_wait,    na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    travel_mob = pmax(0, mean_resp - mean_queue)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(travel_mob, mean_queue),
    names_to  = "component",
    values_to = "minutes"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    component = factor(component,
                       levels = c("mean_queue", "travel_mob"),
                       labels = c("Queue wait", "Travel + mobilise"))
  )

ggplot(decomp, aes(x = category, y = minutes, fill = component)) +

    title = "Response-time decomposition by call category",

    x = "Call category",
    y = "Mean response time (minutes)",

  ) +
```

# 16. Figure D: ambulance capacity vs demand across the week (NEW)

Sustainable throughput is the maximum call rate the current ambulance
pool could sustain given the mean job-cycle length. Where demand
approaches or exceeds throughput, queueing happens.

```{r fig-capacity-vs-demand, fig.height=4, fig.width=10}
# Mean job cycle (minutes), weighted by category mix and conveyance rate
mean_job_cycle <- local({
  # Rough weighted mean: mob + travel + scene + (convey_p * transport) + (convey_p * handover) + clear
  w <- cat_share
  job <- function(cat) {
    row <- function(cmp) job_params[job_params$component == cmp, ][[cat]]
    p   <- convey_prob[[cat]]
    row("mobilise") + row("travel") + row("scene") +
      p * row("transport") + p * row("handover") +
      row("clear")
  }
  sum(sapply(names(w), job) * w)
})
mean_job_cycle  

# Demand: average incidents/hour for each of the 168 hour cells
demand_per_hour <- as.numeric(t(weekly_total))   # 7 days x 24 hours, rowwise
# Throughput: staff / (job_cycle in hours) = staff * 60 / job_cycle (per hr)
throughput_per_hour <- weekly_staff_by_hour * 60 / mean_job_cycle

cap_demand_df <- tibble::tibble(
  index      = seq_along(demand_per_hour),
  hour_of_week = index - 1,
  demand     = demand_per_hour,
  throughput = throughput_per_hour,
  day_idx    = floor(hour_of_week / 24) + 1,
  hour       = hour_of_week %% 24,
  day        = factor(day_order[day_idx], levels = day_order)
)

day_breaks <- tibble::tibble(
  x     = seq(0, 168, by = 24),
  label = c(day_order, "Mon")
)

ggplot(cap_demand_df, aes(x = hour_of_week)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = throughput),
              fill = "grey85", alpha = 0.7) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = seq(24, 144, by = 24),
             colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = day_breaks$x, labels = day_breaks$label,
                     expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 168)) +
  labs(
    title = "Sustainable throughput (grey) vs incident demand (red) across the week",

  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
```

# 17. Figure: queue length by time of day (category-stacked)

```{r fig-queue-by-hour, fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
cats <- c("C1","C2","C3","C4")
queue_intervals <- baseline_run$arrivals %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    baseline_run$attrs %>% dplyr::select(name, category, rep, queue_wait, expired),
    by = c("name", "category", "rep")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    expired    = dplyr::coalesce(expired, 0),
    queue_wait = dplyr::coalesce(queue_wait, 0),
    queue_start = pmax(start_time, warm_up),
    queue_end = dplyr::case_when(
      expired == 1 ~ pmin(end_time, sim_horizon),
      TRUE         ~ pmin(start_time + queue_wait, sim_horizon)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(category %in% cats, queue_end > queue_start)

make_minute_queue <- function(df, warm_up, sim_horizon) {
  n_min <- sim_horizon - warm_up
  delta <- numeric(n_min + 1)
  if (nrow(df) > 0) {
    s <- pmin(pmax(0, ceiling(df$queue_start - warm_up)), n_min - 1)
    e <- pmin(pmax(0, ceiling(df$queue_end   - warm_up)), n_min)
    for (i in seq_along(s)) {
      delta[s[i] + 1] <- delta[s[i] + 1] + 1
      if (e[i] + 1 <= n_min + 1) delta[e[i] + 1] <- delta[e[i] + 1] - 1
    }
  }
  tibble::tibble(time  = warm_up + 0:(n_min - 1),
                 queue = cumsum(delta)[1:n_min])
}

rc_pairs <- queue_intervals %>% dplyr::distinct(rep, category)

minute_queue <- purrr::pmap_dfr(
  rc_pairs, function(rep, category) {
    make_minute_queue(
      df = queue_intervals %>% dplyr::filter(rep == !!rep, category == !!category),
      warm_up = warm_up, sim_horizon = sim_horizon
    ) %>% dplyr::mutate(rep = rep, category = category)
  }
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    hour_of_day = floor((time %% (24 * 60)) / 60),
    block       = floor(hour_of_day / 2) * 2
  )

# Per-category stacked means
queue_cat_by_block <- minute_queue %>%
  dplyr::group_by(rep, block, category) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_q = mean(queue), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(block, category) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_queue = mean(mean_q), .groups = "drop")

# Total queue CI across reps for error bars
queue_ci <- minute_queue %>%
  dplyr::group_by(rep, block, time) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(total_q = sum(queue), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(rep, block) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(rep_mean = mean(total_q), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(block) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_total = mean(rep_mean),
    se         = sd(rep_mean) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
    lwr        = pmax(0, mean_total - 1.96 * se),
    upr        = mean_total + 1.96 * se,
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

ggplot(queue_cat_by_block,
       aes(x = block, y = mean_queue, fill = category)) +
  geom_col(width = 1.6, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(data = queue_ci,
                aes(x = block, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
                inherit.aes = FALSE,
                width = 0.7, linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 22, 2)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(C1 = "#E24B4A", C2 = "#1D9E75",
                               C3 = "#378ADD", C4 = "#BA7517")) +
  labs(title    = "Mean ambulance-queue length by time of day",
       x = "Hour of day", y = "Mean queue length", fill = "Category") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

# 20. Sensitivity analysis

```{r sens-grid}
# Four one-way sensitivity parameters:
#   Demand      +/-10%
#   Staff       +/-10%
#   Handover    +/-1 bay 
#   Conveyance  +/-10%
scenario_grid <- tibble::tribble(
  ~scenario,           ~parameter,          ~level,      ~demand_mult, ~staff_mult, ~handover_capacity_delta, ~convey_mult, ~shape_mult,
  "Demand low",        "Demand",            "Low",       0.90,         1.00,        0,                        1.00,         1.00,
  "Demand baseline",   "Demand",            "Baseline",  1.00,         1.00,        0,                        1.00,         1.00,
  "Demand high",       "Demand",            "High",      1.10,         1.00,        0,                        1.00,         1.00,

  "Staff low",         "Staff",             "Low",       1.00,         0.90,        0,                        1.00,         1.00,
  "Staff baseline",    "Staff",             "Baseline",  1.00,         1.00,        0,                        1.00,         1.00,
  "Staff high",        "Staff",             "High",      1.00,         1.10,        0,                        1.00,         1.00,

  "Handover low",      "Handover bays",     "Low",       1.00,         1.00,       -1,                        1.00,         1.00,
  "Handover baseline", "Handover bays",     "Baseline",  1.00,         1.00,        0,                        1.00,         1.00,
  "Handover high",     "Handover bays",     "High",      1.00,         1.00,       +1,                        1.00,         1.00,

  "Conveyance low",    "Conveyance",        "Low",       1.00,         1.00,        0,                        0.90,         1.00,
  "Conveyance baseline","Conveyance",       "Baseline",  1.00,         1.00,        0,                        1.00,         1.00,
  "Conveyance high",   "Conveyance",        "High",      1.00,         1.00,        0,                        1.10,         1.00
)
```

```{r run-sens}
scenario_runs <- cached("des_scenario_runs.rds", purrr::pmap(
  scenario_grid,
  function(scenario, parameter, level, demand_mult, staff_mult,
           handover_capacity_delta, convey_mult, shape_mult) {

    run <- run_one_scenario(
      scenario_name           = scenario,
      demand_mult             = demand_mult,
      staff_mult              = staff_mult,
      handover_capacity_delta = handover_capacity_delta,
      convey_mult             = convey_mult,
      shape_mult              = shape_mult,
      n_rep                   = n_rep_sens,
      seed_start              = 4001
    )

    # Keep only the important outputs, drop the per-call detail
    light <- list(
      scenario             = run$scenario,
      kpis_by_category     = run$kpis_by_category,
      kpis_by_category_all = run$kpis_by_category_all,
      resource_summary_all = run$resource_summary_all,
      handover_summary_all = run$handover_summary_all
    )

    rm(run); gc()
    light
  }
))
```

```{r build-sens-results}

sens_results <- purrr::map_dfr(scenario_runs, function(run) {
  grid_row <- scenario_grid[scenario_grid$scenario == run$scenario, ]

  ho_mean       <- mean(run$handover_summary_all$mean_handover, na.rm = TRUE)
  ho_queue_mean <- mean(run$handover_summary_all$mean_ho_queue, na.rm = TRUE)

  run$kpis_by_category %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      scenario               = run$scenario,
      parameter              = grid_row$parameter[1],
      level                  = grid_row$level[1],
      mean_handover_duration = ho_mean,
      mean_ho_queue_wait     = ho_queue_mean
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(scenario, parameter, level, category,
                  mean_queue_wait, mean_response_time,
                  mean_handover_duration, mean_ho_queue_wait)
})
```

```{r fig-sens, fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
# Per-category sensitivity: response time and queue wait only.

sens_plot <- sens_results %>%
  dplyr::select(parameter, level, category,
                mean_queue_wait, mean_response_time) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(mean_queue_wait, mean_response_time),
                      names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    metric    = dplyr::recode(metric,
                              mean_queue_wait    = "Mean call queue wait",
                              mean_response_time = "Mean response time"),
    category  = factor(category, levels = c("C1","C2","C3","C4")),
    level     = factor(level,    levels = c("Low","Baseline","High")),
    parameter = factor(parameter,
                       levels = c("Demand","Staff","Handover bays","Conveyance"))
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = level, values_from = value)

make_panel <- function(metric_name) {
  sens_plot %>%
    dplyr::filter(metric == metric_name) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = category)) +
    geom_linerange(aes(ymin = pmin(Low, High), ymax = pmax(Low, High)),
                   linewidth = 0.8, colour = "grey65") +
    geom_point(aes(y = Low),      colour = "#D55E00", size = 2.6) +
    geom_point(aes(y = High),     colour = "#009E73", size = 2.6) +
    geom_point(aes(y = Baseline), colour = "black",   size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(~ parameter, scales = "fixed", nrow = 1) +
    labs(title = metric_name, x = NULL, y = "Minutes") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
}

  make_panel("Mean call queue wait") +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(
    title = "One-way sensitivity: low (orange), baseline (black), high (green)",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13))
  )
```

```{r fig-sens-handover, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=9}
ho_sens <- sens_results %>%
  dplyr::distinct(parameter, level, mean_ho_queue_wait) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    level     = factor(level, levels = c("Low","Baseline","High")),
    parameter = factor(parameter,
                       levels = c("Demand","Staff","Handover bays","Conveyance"))
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = level, values_from = mean_ho_queue_wait)

ggplot(ho_sens, aes(x = parameter)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = parameter, y = Low, yend = Baseline),
               linewidth = 0.8, colour = "grey65") +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = parameter, y = Baseline, yend = High),
               linewidth = 0.8, colour = "grey65") +
  geom_point(aes(y = Low),      colour = "#D55E00", size = 3) +
  geom_point(aes(y = High),     colour = "#009E73", size = 3) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Baseline), colour = "black",   size = 3.5) +
  labs(title = "Sensitivity of mean handover queue wait",
       subtitle = "Low (orange), baseline (black), high (green)",
       x = NULL, y = "Minutes") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey40"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
```

```{r fig-tornado, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=7}
tornado <- sens_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(category == "C2") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(parameter) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    low  = mean_queue_wait[level == "Low"],
    base = mean_queue_wait[level == "Baseline"],
    high = mean_queue_wait[level == "High"],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    low_delta  = low  - base,
    high_delta = high - base,
    impact     = pmax(abs(low_delta), abs(high_delta))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(impact)

tornado_long <- tornado %>%
  dplyr::mutate(parameter = factor(parameter, levels = parameter)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(low_delta, high_delta),
                      names_to = "direction", values_to = "delta") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(direction = dplyr::recode(direction,
                                          low_delta  = "Low",
                                          high_delta = "High"))

ggplot(tornado_long,
       aes(x = delta, y = parameter, fill = direction)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Low = "#00BFC4", High = "#F8766D")) +
  labs(title = "Tornado: effect of +/-10 percent on C2 mean queue wait",
       x = "Change vs baseline (minutes)", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```

```{r fig-stress-response-cdf, fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
# Compare response-time distributions between baseline (5 bays) and stress (4 bays) scenarios, by call category.

resp_baseline <- baseline_run$attrs %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(response_time)) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(category, minutes = response_time,
                   scenario = "Baseline (5 bays)")

resp_stress <- stress_run$attrs %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(response_time)) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(category, minutes = response_time,
                   scenario = "Stress (4 bays)")

resp_combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(resp_baseline, resp_stress) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    category = factor(category, levels = c("C1","C2","C3","C4")),
    scenario = factor(scenario, levels = c("Baseline (5 bays)",
                                           "Stress (4 bays)"))
  )


ggplot(resp_combined,
       aes(x = minutes, colour = scenario, linetype = scenario)) +
  stat_ecdf(geom = "step", linewidth = 0.9) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 60))  +
  facet_wrap(~ category, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Baseline (5 bays)" = "#222222",
                                 "Stress (4 bays)"   = "#D55E00")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Baseline (5 bays)" = "solid",
                                   "Stress (4 bays)"   = "dashed")) +
  labs(title = "Response time CDFs: baseline vs stress scenario",
       x = "Response time (minutes)",
       y = "Cumulative probability",
       colour = NULL, linetype = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
```

```{r}
# Baseline handover queue wait - CI across replications
baseline_ci <- scenario_runs[[which(scenario_grid$scenario == "Handover baseline")]]$handover_summary_all %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n  = dplyr::n(),
    mu = mean(mean_ho_queue),
    se = sd(mean_ho_queue) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
    lo = mu - qt(0.975, n - 1) * se,
    hi = mu + qt(0.975, n - 1) * se
  )

# Stress handover queue wait - CI across replications
stress_ci <- scenario_runs[[which(scenario_grid$scenario == "Handover low")]]$handover_summary_all %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n  = dplyr::n(),
    mu = mean(mean_ho_queue),
    se = sd(mean_ho_queue) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
    lo = mu - qt(0.975, n - 1) * se,
    hi = mu + qt(0.975, n - 1) * se
  )

baseline_ci
stress_ci
```
